video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Meleek Thomas Media Availability | 10.03.2026

quotes.speaker: Meleek Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Meleek Thomas on the increased pace and punctuality of NBA training camp
quotes.excerpt: Everything has to be very punctual. You have to get to the next action quick.
quotes.quote: The biggest adjustment for me from playing in college to now being in training camp has been being more punctual. In college, you have a little bit more time to think. In the league, especially in training camp right now when everything is going so fast, everything has to be very punctual. You have to get to the next action quick. You have to make a decision quick. I am seeing it before we get to the games, so I say punctuality and just being precise with what I do.
quotes.social_post: Meleek Thomas says the biggest adjustment from college to the NBA has been the speed of the game. He notes that everything in training camp has to be very punctual and you have to make decisions quick.

quotes.speaker: Meleek Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Meleek Thomas on his role and impact with the Cleveland Cavaliers
quotes.excerpt: I am most excited to impact winning for my team. I am most excited to learn.
quotes.quote: I am most excited to impact winning for my team. I am most excited to learn how to excel and expand my role as the season goes along. Once I get to establish myself in the league and for my team and then build on it and let my role grow, that is what I am most excited for. I am not looking to do anything specific because I know as I take care of business, as I learn before the season starts, everything is going to flow how I need it to during the games.
quotes.social_post: Meleek Thomas is focused on impacting winning for the Cavaliers this season. He says he is not looking to do anything specific yet and is focused on letting his role grow as he establishes himself.

quotes.speaker: Meleek Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Meleek Thomas on the potential benefits of an NBA-backed league in Europe
quotes.excerpt: I feel like that would give players coming out of college different experiences.
quotes.quote: I feel like that would give players coming out of college different experiences. From overseas players to college players, players are just looking for different experiences. I think that would be a great thing because if it is taken as seriously as the NBA is, just a Europe league, then I feel it benefits them, benefits their family, benefits their future, allowed them to compete in a different league without being in the direct NBA. But if it has NBA attached to it and it is very competitive and it is taken as serious, I feel it can be a beneficial for some guys.
quotes.social_post: Meleek Thomas shares his thoughts on a potential NBA-backed league in Europe, saying it could be a great thing for players looking for different experiences if it is taken as seriously as the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Meleek Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Meleek Thomas on his relationship with Jose Calderon
quotes.excerpt: To be in the same organization as him is pretty special.
quotes.quote: Jose Calderon, I was very familiar with his game and now to be in the same organization as him is pretty special. I told him today that I am very appreciative for him having me here specifically and having my teammates here and all of us as one organization just because it takes a lot to infiltrate like a whole camp like this in a different country. You have to price everything out. You have to know everybody stands. So for him to orchestrate that and get that all together with the organization is big time in my opinion.
quotes.social_post: Meleek Thomas calls it special to be in the same organization as Jose Calderon, praising him for his work in orchestrating the team's training camp logistics.

quotes.speaker: Meleek Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Meleek Thomas on his development with Cavs coaching staff
quotes.excerpt: Johnny Bryant has been amazing in my development. Omar Cook has been amazing.
quotes.quote: My time in college and who I was working with was Kenny Payne and Chin Coleman, Tyler Ulis at times. I had a lot of basketball knowledge around me. In college, everything was individualized to what I needed. Now I am here learning how to screen, I am here learning how to manipulate the game, where to be at, how to play off of the ones around me. Johnny Bryant has been amazing in my development. Omar Cook has been amazing. Daniel has also helped me in my development. We have a great team of player development coaches here and I feel like they can all make our team rise.
quotes.social_post: Meleek Thomas credits Cavs coaches Johnny Bryant and Omar Cook for his development, noting he is currently learning how to screen and manipulate the game at the NBA level.

quotes.speaker: Meleek Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Meleek Thomas on Jared Allen's veteran presence
quotes.excerpt: He does it like a vet. He does it like he has been doing it for many years.
quotes.quote: He is not flashy. He is not loud. Very quiet, but when it comes to doing his job, playing his role, he does it to the T. He does it like a vet. He does it like he has been doing it for many years. He knows where to be at as cat and mouse game when it comes to ball screens. It is very grateful for his position to be able to play that in-between game and make the guards have tougher decisions. He cleans up the rim. His putbacks are elite. Where he is at around the basket is elite. His hands are elite when it comes to catching the basketball and dunking the basketball.
quotes.social_post: Meleek Thomas praises Jarrett Allen as a veteran presence, calling his rim protection and hands elite. He says Allen plays his role to the T and knows how to make the game difficult for opposing guards.

quotes.speaker: Meleek Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Meleek Thomas on learning to impact the game defensively
quotes.excerpt: I am learning how to impact defense by getting more deflections, being where I am supposed to be.
quotes.quote: In this training camp, what I am learning about how to impact the game in many different ways is crashing more, crashing offensive glass, defensive glass more. I can impact defense by getting more deflections, being where I am supposed to be at. Because if I am where I am supposed to be at, then they know they can rely on me on defense. If I am where I am supposed to be at on offense, they know I am a reliable screen setter. I am in more actions. I can come off of flares. Just me being in the right spots and being a willing learner, learning to expand my knowing and my knowledge of where to be and when to be there gets me more looks offense and defense.
quotes.social_post: Meleek Thomas says he is learning to impact the game defensively by crashing the glass and focusing on deflections. He emphasizes that being in the right spots is key to becoming a reliable player for the team.
